item.title: Man Driving Electric Car Blasting Nicki Minaj Clearly Right-Wing
item.description: BEVERLY HILLS, CA — According to sources, locals noticed a local man driving an electric car down Rodeo Drive and blasting Nicki Minaj out of his open windows - clearly outing himself as a Right-winger.

item.title: Man Thought Adult Christmases Would Have A Lot More Surprise Cars With Giant Bows On Top
item.description: BLUFFTON, IN — Local man Mark Connors wouldn't describe himself as ungrateful so much as surprised to learn that, as an adult, Christmas didn't involve more cars with giant bows on them waiting outside.

item.title: Nicki Minaj Reveals Hit Song 'Anaconda' Is Actually About How The Federal Government Needs To Reduce Deficit Spending
item.description: PHOENIX, AZ — Following her surprising appearance onstage with Erika Kirk at Turning Point USA's AmFest, rapper Nicki Minaj revealed that her hit song "Anaconda" was actually about how the federal government needs to reduce deficit spending.

item.title: 10 Clear Signs Of Christian Persecution To Look For This Christmas
item.description: It goes without saying that Christians in America have it harder than anyone else, but the persecution always seems to get even worse during the Christmas season. Need proof? Look no further.

item.title: Exclusive Sneak Peek At Next Year's AmFest Lineup
item.description: The curtain had not yet fallen on Turning Point USA's AmFest 2025 before rumors swirled about how they were going to top it next year. How do you follow up such a wild show?
